changelog.en: Installed add-ons with an update now have a button with an arrow in the list: it updates the add-on or removes it. "Available updates" offers Remove as well.
changelog.de: Installierte Add-ons mit Update haben in der Liste jetzt einen Knopf mit Pfeil: Darüber aktualisieren oder entfernen Sie das Add-on. Auch unter „Verfügbare Updates“ steht „Entfernen“ bereit.
changelog.fr: Les compléments installés avec une mise à jour ont désormais un bouton avec une flèche dans la liste : il permet de mettre à jour ou de supprimer le complément. « Mises à jour disponibles » propose aussi Supprimer.
changelog.it: I componenti aggiuntivi installati con un aggiornamento hanno ora nell'elenco un pulsante con una freccia: permette di aggiornarli o rimuoverli. Anche «Aggiornamenti disponibili» offre Rimuovi.
changelog.es: Los complementos instalados con una actualización tienen ahora en la lista un botón con flecha: permite actualizarlos o quitarlos. «Actualizaciones disponibles» también ofrece Quitar.
changelog.nl: Geïnstalleerde invoegtoepassingen met een update hebben in de lijst nu een knop met een pijl: daarmee werkt u de invoegtoepassing bij of verwijdert u haar. Ook "Beschikbare updates" biedt Verwijderen.
changelog.pt: Os suplementos instalados com uma atualização têm agora na lista um botão com seta: permite atualizá-los ou removê-los. «Atualizações disponíveis» também oferece Remover.
changelog.da: Installerede tilføjelser med en opdatering har nu en knap med en pil på listen: Den opdaterer eller fjerner tilføjelsen. "Tilgængelige opdateringer" tilbyder også Fjern.
changelog.fi: Asennetuilla lisäosilla, joihin on päivitys, on nyt luettelossa nuolellinen painike: sillä lisäosan voi päivittää tai poistaa. Myös "Saatavilla olevat päivitykset" tarjoaa Poista-vaihtoehdon.
changelog.nb: Installerte tillegg med en oppdatering har nå en knapp med pil i listen: Den oppdaterer eller fjerner tillegget. "Tilgjengelige oppdateringer" tilbyr også Fjern.
changelog.sv: Installerade tillägg med en uppdatering har nu en knapp med en pil i listan: den uppdaterar eller tar bort tillägget. "Tillgängliga uppdateringar" erbjuder också Ta bort.
changelog.pl: Zainstalowane dodatki z aktualizacją mają teraz na liście przycisk ze strzałką: pozwala zaktualizować lub usunąć dodatek. W „Dostępnych aktualizacjach” jest też opcja Usuń.
changelog.cs: Nainstalované doplňky s aktualizací mají nyní v seznamu tlačítko se šipkou: doplněk jím aktualizujete nebo odeberete. I „Dostupné aktualizace“ nabízejí Odebrat.
changelog.hu: A frissítéssel rendelkező telepített bővítmények a listában most nyíllal ellátott gombot kapnak: ezzel frissítheti vagy eltávolíthatja a bővítményt. Az „Elérhető frissítések” nézet is kínálja az Eltávolítás lehetőséget.
changelog.ru: У установленных надстроек с обновлением в списке теперь есть кнопка со стрелкой: через неё надстройку можно обновить или удалить. В разделе «Доступные обновления» также есть «Удалить».
changelog.tr: Güncellemesi olan yüklü eklentilerin listede artık oklu bir düğmesi var: eklentiyi bununla güncelleyebilir veya kaldırabilirsiniz. "Kullanılabilir güncellemeler" de Kaldır seçeneğini sunar.
changelog.zh-Hans: 有更新的已安装加载项现在在列表中显示一个带箭头的按钮：可用它更新或移除加载项。“可用更新”中也提供“移除”。
changelog.zh-Hant: 有更新的已安裝增益集現在在清單中顯示一個帶箭頭的按鈕：可用它更新或移除增益集。「可用的更新」中也提供「移除」。
changelog.ja: 更新のあるインストール済みアドオンには、一覧に矢印付きのボタンが表示されるようになりました。ここからアドオンを更新または削除できます。「利用可能な更新」でも「削除」を選べます。
changelog.ko: 업데이트가 있는 설치된 추가 기능에 이제 목록에서 화살표가 있는 단추가 표시됩니다. 이 단추로 추가 기능을 업데이트하거나 제거할 수 있습니다. "사용 가능한 업데이트"에서도 제거를 선택할 수 있습니다.
changelog.ar: أصبح للوظائف الإضافية المثبتة التي يتوفر لها تحديث زر بسهم في القائمة: يمكنك من خلاله تحديث الوظيفة الإضافية أو إزالتها. وتتيح "التحديثات المتوفرة" أيضاً خيار الإزالة.

complianceAudit.method: Checked all #include directives and linker inputs of PluginStore.vcxproj (Windows SDK incl. BCrypt/Crypt32 for SHA-256 and the ECDSA signature check, MFC/ATL, Tungsten Power PDF Plugin SDK only), the bundled UILayout and icon files (own work, icons drawn by client/res/make_icons.py) and the package contents. One third-party component: the Microsoft WebView2 SDK static loader (BSD-3-Clause), linked into PluginStore.zxt; its NOTICE lists only BSD-licensed .NET tooling that is not used. The bundled MSI is built with the WiX Toolset 3.14 (build tool only): since 1.9.13 it contains no WiX runtime parts (own dialogs, texts and banner; the quote page opens through explorer.exe; Windows Installer's Restart Manager closes Power PDF on request), checked in the Binary, CustomAction and Dialog tables of all 21 language versions. No credentials, personal data or third-party trademarks in the package. The only network service is the configured Add-on Store server (HTTPS). Since 1.9.8 the setup shows, on a Power PDF licensed with a serial number, a dialog whose button "Request a quote" opens Tungsten Automation's public quote page in the default browser (only on that click, never in silent installs); the setup itself sends nothing. The MSI also installs AddonStoreLink.exe (own code, no network access), which handles addonstore:// links by passing a validated package id to the client. Since 1.9.11 the store window page uses the Tungsten Plug-in UI kit 1.0.1 (client/third_party/tpui: own code of Tungsten Automation, MIT; CSS inlined into the page at build time, no network access).

externalServices.name: Add-on Store server (configurable; default addon.power-pdf.de, Azure address ppdf-store.azurewebsites.net)
externalServices.data: Catalog, search and package downloads; sends the Power PDF UI language, the beta channel flag and, only when the user or IT entered one, the customer code of a delivery (X-Customer-Code header). The catalog is also read once in the background about 15 seconds after Power PDF starts and after the store window closes, to show the update badge (IT can switch this off with the policy UpdateBadge = 0). No personal data, no documents.

externalServices.name: Tungsten Automation quote page (setup only, serial-number Power PDF)
externalServices.data: None from the setup: the button opens the public page in the default browser (tungstenautomation.de for German, .fr for French, .com otherwise); the browser then talks to that website as with any link.

elevation.reason: Installing, updating and removing add-ons writes to Power PDF's Plug-Ins folder in Program Files: one PowerShell step runs elevated after the UAC prompt, only when the user installs, updates or removes an add-on (the self-update starts msiexec the same way).
